description: This Java class defines an abstract class for an incognito mode feature in a custom keyboard application, managing incognito state based on input context and user preferences.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardIncognito
classes.description: An abstract class extending keyboard functionality to include incognito mode management based on input type and options.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Overrides the method to initialize incognito mode based on input info when input view starts.

methods.name: isNumberPassword
methods.description: Checks if the input type indicates a number password.

methods.name: isNoPersonalizedLearning
methods.description: Checks if the input options specify no personalized learning.

methods.name: setIncognito
methods.description: Sets the incognito mode state, updates related UI and internal flags.
